post.description: Search USAspending prime awards by keyword, awarding/funding agency, recipient name or UEI, action-date window, place of performance, NAICS, PSC and award amount within one award family (contracts, IDVs, grants, loans, direct payments or other). One page (default 20, max 100) of summary award records with an opaque cursor for the next page; add `award` for the full record.

award_amounts.description: USD ranges (OR) on the award total; at least one bound each.

award_type_codes.description: Required. One family only: contracts A (BPA call), B (purchase order), C (delivery order), D (definitive contract); IDVs IDV_A..IDV_E; grants 02 block, 03 formula, 04 project, 05 cooperative agreement; direct payments 06, 10; loans 07 direct, 08 guaranteed; other 09 insurance, 11 other, -1.

cursor.description: next_cursor from the previous page; bound to identical filters, sort and page_size. Depth is capped at 500 pages.

keywords.description: Free-text terms matched against award descriptions, recipient names and ids (OR).

naics_codes.description: Contracts/IDVs only; 2, 4 or 6 digit NAICS codes (sector, industry group or national industry). USAspending rejects other lengths.

page_size.description:
page_size

Provider reference: minimum 1; maximum 100; default 20.

recipient_search_text.description: Recipient name, UEI or DUNS text.

sort.description:
Result order. For loans amount_* sorts by Loan Value and start_date_* by Issued Date; end_date_* is rejected for loans.

Provider reference: allowed values ["amount_desc", "amount_asc", "start_date_desc", "start_date_asc", "end_date_desc", "end_date_asc", "last_modified_desc", "last_modified_asc", "recipient_name_asc", "recipient_name_desc", "award_id_asc", "award_id_desc"]; default "amount_desc".
